entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-08
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • ImmutableSortedSet<T>.Builder: enumerating through IEnumerable<T> doesn't throw on modification and can return wrong items #137167
  • OpenSSL shim treats -1 from OCSP_basic_verify and X509_STORE_CTX_get1_issuer as success #137162
  • System.Text.Json.Serialization.Tests.PipeTests_Async.VeryLargeJsonFileTest test failure (OutOfMemoryException) #137161
  • DacDbiComWrappersDumpTests failure #137160
  • JIT: final Tier1 (after Instrumented Tier1 from R2R) of an async MoveNext uses 13-25 GB in guarded devirtualization on 10.0.14 linux-arm64 #137155
  • Repeated failed LoadFromAssemblyPath on a native DLL ends in 'Stack overflow.' and a hung process instead of BadImageFormatException #137153
  • [ci-scan] Hang: Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.Functional.Tests times out on MacCatalyst after 4500 seconds #137152
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: ECKeyFileTests explicit NIST P-256 imports unexpectedly succeed on Azure Linux 4 #137151
  • [ci-scan] Build break: Apple x64 NativeAOT apps cannot link CryptoKit SHA3 symbols #137150
